# Ideal Medical Care

> > A comprehensive physician wellness and suicide prevention platform founded by Dr. Pamela Wible, offering crisis support, peer groups, retreats, and educational resources for doctors in distress.

Ideal Medical Care is dedicated to addressing physician mental health, burnout, and suicide prevention through direct support services, educational content, and advocacy. Led by Dr. Pamela Wible, the organization combines crisis intervention with long-term wellness solutions including peer support groups, retreats, and published resources on physician wellbeing and the systemic challenges within medical practice.

## Key Topics

- Physician suicide prevention
- Physician burnout
- Physician mental health
- Peer support groups
- Doctor wellness
- Medical ethics
- Physician depression
- Crisis intervention
- Medical education
- Physician Health Programs (PHP)
- Pamela Wible MD
- Legal risks for physicians
- Physician retreats
- Doctor support networks

## Crisis Support & Peer Services

- [Physician Suicide Hotline | Doctor Suicide Prevention | Physician Peer Support](https://www.idealmedicalcare.org): Pamela Wible MD's physician suicide prevention & peer support hotline
- [Physician Support Group—Sundays | Peer Support for Doctors](https://www.idealmedicalcare.org/physician-support-groups-every-sunday): Weekly confidential physician peer support groups for crisis intervention
- [Contact - Pamela Wible MD](https://www.idealmedicalcare.org/contact): Contact Dr. Wible for physician wellness consulting & crisis support

## Wellness Programs & Retreats

- [Physician Retreats | Doctor Burnout & Wellness Retreats](https://www.idealmedicalcare.org/physician-retreats): Tax-deductible wellness retreats for physician burnout & healing in Oregon
- [Doctor Suicide Prevention Team - Pamela Wible MD](https://www.idealmedicalcare.org/doctor-suicide-outreach-team): Information on joining the Doctor Suicide Dream Team initiative

## Educational Resources & Publications

- [Books - Pamela Wible MD](https://www.idealmedicalcare.org/medical-books): Free downloadable books on physician suicide & wellness by Dr. Wible
- [Why Physicians Commit Suicide - Pamela Wible MD](https://www.idealmedicalcare.org/why-physicians-commit-suicide): Guide exploring hidden reasons why doctors commit suicide
- [Why "Happy" Doctors Die By Suicide - Pamela Wible MD](https://www.idealmedicalcare.org/why-happy-doctors-die-by-suicide): Analysis of why seemingly happy doctors die by suicide
- [Physician Depression - What Depressed Doctors Do | Physician Depression Treatment](https://www.idealmedicalcare.org/depressed-doctors-nobodys-looking): Article on depression in physicians & coping mechanisms

## Speaking & Media

- [Speaking - Pamela Wible MD](https://www.idealmedicalcare.org/speaking): Dr. Wible's keynote speeches & TED talks on physician wellness
- [TEDMED Talk: Why Doctors Kill Themselves - Pamela Wible MD](https://www.idealmedicalcare.org/tedmed-talk-why-doctors-kill-themselves): TEDMED talk on physician suicide prevention
- [Keynote: Finding your bliss—beating physician "burnout" - Pamela Wible MD](https://www.idealmedicalcare.org/keynote-finding-your-bliss-beating-physician-burnout): Keynote address on beating physician burnout & finding fulfillment
- [Media - Pamela Wible MD](https://www.idealmedicalcare.org/media): Media appearances & press resources on physician suicide prevention

## Legal & Professional Guidance

- [Physician Felons: How to Stay Out of Prison - Pamela Wible MD](https://www.idealmedicalcare.org/physician-felons-how-to-stay-out-of-prison): Guide on protecting medical license from legal prosecution
- [Why good doctors go to prison - Pamela Wible MD](https://www.idealmedicalcare.org/why-good-doctors-go-to-prison): Guide with 12 tips to avoid FBI/DEA prosecution for physicians

## Articles & Analysis

- [Is medical school an anti-mentorship program? - Pamela Wible MD](https://www.idealmedicalcare.org/is-medical-school-an-anti-mentorship-program): Article examining mentorship gaps in medical education
- [Physician Wellness: An Oxymoron? - Pamela Wible MD](https://www.idealmedicalcare.org/physician-wellness-an-oxymoron): Article examining barriers to physician wellness in medicine
- [Dr. Jonathan Drummond-Webb: His Life & Legacy - Pamela Wible MD](https://www.idealmedicalcare.org/dr-jonathan-drummond-webb-his-life-legacy): Profile of renowned pediatric surgeon who died by suicide
